7193.title: Cross-host retirement starvation
7193.rootCauseOneLine: Awaiting every environment removal keeps the periodic lifecycle job running, so overlapping ticks skip newly expired retirements on other hosts.
7193.proposedFix: Dispatch periodic environment lifecycle work in background mode, following the existing machine lifecycle pattern, while preserving awaited direct calls, operation deduplication, yielding, and cleanup concurrency limits.
7193.caveats: Deterministic server/real-SQLite reproduction repeated by the same agent. Seeds post-deletion state and delays a provider callback; does not verify Windows, Connect, physical worktree deletion, elapsed wall time, or the original session's trigger and clocks.
